summary: FS KKR Capital Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of $900 million aggregate principal amount of 7.500% Notes due 2031. The offering is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf registration statement (Form N-2). Terms include a fixed coupon rate, a 2031 maturity, and a syndicate of underwriters led by BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan, and KKR Capital Markets. No special-situation elements are present; this is a standard capital markets transaction, not a merger, tender, or restructuring. The filing does not involve a price per share, premium, or any event-driven catalyst.
